**Class** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package. Inherits from [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/).

```csharp
public sealed class PrintSystemUnavailableException : PrintException
```

The exception thrown when a print system can't be used: no supported print system is available on the current platform, usually because no Latiprimere platform adapter has been registered for it, or a print system's own service isn't running, such as the Windows Print Spooler.

The printer catalog treats a print system that throws this like any other failing print system: it skips it while others answer, and throws only if every print system fails.
